I need `acc + total` (broadcasting over the last axis) ✓. Since acc is (P+1,N) and total is (N,) → acc + total broadcasts ✓.

Let me fix: `np.concatenate([acc, acc + total], axis=0)` ✓.

Hmm, but wait: is that the right doubling? acc has P+1 rows: acc[q] = the sum of the first q phases ✓. So pref2 = concat(acc, acc + total) → the second half: acc[P+q] + total = the sum of the first P+q terms ✓ (since the sequence repeats) ✓.

So `acc + total` (broadcasting over the last axis) ✓.
